trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Incident:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate had spiked to 18%).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Reviewed deployment history** — found v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was only a staging release).
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — the first attempt partially succeeded in us-east but was halted in us-west and eu-west by an orchestrator error. I retried the rollback and it completed successfully across all regions.
3. **Verified recovery** — checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001)** — titled "checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0" and paged on-call. The first creation attempt timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key to guarantee no duplicate incidents.
